title: Retrieval Augmented Generation or Long-Context LLMs? A Comprehensive Study and Hybrid Approach

model.params_source: assumed (paper silent on decoding); max_tokens 512 covers the longest LongBench generation budget

task.subset_rule: all: LongBench narrativeqa 200, qasper 200, multifieldqa_en 150, hotpotqa 200, 2wikimqa 200, musique 200, qmsum 200; InfiniteBench longbook_qa_eng 351, longbook_choice_eng 229 (Table 6)
task.approximation: Contexts longer than the 128k window are middle-truncated (LongBench convention; the paper says inputs are truncated to the context limit); per-dataset scores use the LongBench / InfiniteBench reference metrics.

items.source: zai-org/LongBench (formerly THUDM/LongBench; data.zip) for the 7 LongBench sets and xinrongzhang2022/InfiniteBench for En.QA (longbook_qa_eng.jsonl) and En.MC (longbook_choice_eng.jsonl)
items.config_or_split: LongBench configs narrativeqa, qasper, multifieldqa_en, hotpotqa, 2wikimqa, musique, qmsum (split test); InfiniteBench splits longbook_qa_eng, longbook_choice_eng
items.license: LongBench: MIT (GitHub release; no tag on the dataset card); InfiniteBench: Apache-2.0
items.access_note: zai-org/LongBench: loading script + data.zip (114 MB, zip is not a supported format; Hub parquet API answers 400); xinrongzhang2022/InfiniteBench: longbook_qa_eng.jsonl 298 MB and longbook_choice_eng.jsonl 186 MB (> 100 MB each; not downloaded)

output.postprocess: strip; LongBench normalization (lowercase, remove punctuation/articles) inside the F1 scorer
output.parse_prose: free text (QA/summarization); En.MC: regex first letter A-D

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: unweighted mean over the 9 datasets of the per-dataset score: token-level QA F1 (LongBench qa_f1_score) for NarrativeQA, Qasper, MultiFieldQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue and En.QA, ROUGE-L for QMSum, accuracy for En.MC; each x100.
metric.original_location: Table 1, GPT-4O block, row 2-1 LC, column Avg

open_points: runner gap: nine datasets, each with its own template and source (per-field / per-dataset template selection and a list of sources).

runner gap: per-dataset metrics (LongBench token-F1 with its normalisation for 7 sets, ROUGE-L for QMSum, accuracy for En.MC) averaged - only rouge_l/exact_match exist; gold 'answers' is a LIST of references (max over references) which the runner's scorers do not handle.
runner gap: middle-truncation of contexts to the 128k window is not available (no truncation rule).
sources: LongBench ships as data.zip (114 MB) behind a loading script and InfiniteBench files exceed 100 MB - not downloaded.
cost: ~$500 at one seed (Table 1 GPT-4O LC row); a human must approve or subset per dataset.

hook download limit: LongBench data.zip (114 MB) and the InfiniteBench files (298 MB, 186 MB) exceed the 100 MB per-file limit for hook downloads; a human must stage the nine test files locally (items.file_url per dataset) before a per-dataset template/metric hook can run
notes: InfiniteBench contexts average ~150k words (>128k tokens) so ~580 calls run at the full 128k window; LongBench contexts average 4-18k words. Per-dataset values in Table 1 (32.78, 44.54, 55.28, 62.42, 70.69, 41.65, 21.92, 32.36, 76.42) allow a per-dataset check.
runner_gaps: prompt: template selected by an item field
items: several sources / zip archives / truncation
metric: token-F1 with a list of references
